items.q: Show me the fella," his name is MacDermott. Okay, I'll take care of it. ... I went on the stage and I said, "Mr. MacDermott, my partner was telling me that you want to move the piano...

Come back and says, you got the wrong theater, the theater is the west side theater, I think he said the Ordean Theater over on the west side. Okay. So they expect you there. That's okay. I go to the theater, rehearse, go on do the show, the same guy that produces the show that Paul Ash is in, he went to see the show, too. He went to catch the show. When he caught the show, he came back to the theater and we got the message that…

Don't cry about it, I'll go down with ya and we'll see what it is." So he takes me downstairs, "Show me the fella," his name is MacDermott. Okay, I'll take care of it.
